newsitem.title: USA: Lifecore backs Q4 earnings estimates.
newsitem.headline: Lifecore backs Q4 earnings estimates.

text.p: Lifecore Biomedical Inc chief executive James Bracke said Wednesday that analysts' estimates that the company will earn $0.01 a share in the fourth quarter were accurate.
"We're comfortable with that," Bracke said in an interview after a speech to investors at a Piper Jaffray conference here. "To the best of my knowledge, it's accurate."
For the full year, Lifecore chief financial officer Dennis Allingham said analysts' estimates of a loss of $0.08 a share was in line with the company's expectations.
"We're comfortable. Our numbers are tracking what the analysts have on the Street," he said.
Bracke said he expected the company's clinical trial for Lubricoat, a product used to reduce post-surgical adhesions, would be completed in September or October.
The company will target research and development spending on clinical trials of Lubricoat in Japan or on verifying Lubricoat's cardiovascular application.

"Our R&D spending priority will probably be related to continuing clinical trials in Japan for Lubricoat or products like that, or trials to verify expanded cardiovascular claims for Lubricoat," Bracke said.
